acceptanceCriteria: The snapshot sweep also removes stale blob-*.tmp files in shard subdirectories and stale .gitignore-*.tmp files, with the same age cutoff as snapshot-*.tmp, and a regression test plants each orphan and shows it removed while a fresh one survives.
body: Found 2026-09-26 while integrating V1-0286 at 2961076f. The snapshot sweep (internal/contextindex/snapshot.go:464) removes only stale snapshot-*.tmp files in the snapshot directory. publishBlobFactAt (internal/contextindex/blob_shards_open.go:105) writes blob-<random>.tmp in each shard subdirectory, and the .gitignore writer (internal/contextindex/snapshot.go:396) writes .gitignore-*.tmp; both rely only on a deferred Remove. A process killed between create and rename (SIGKILL, host kill of a hook) leaves these files forever. Related to V1-0302, which covers the hour-long survival of snapshot-*.tmp and the missing byte budget.

title: index snapshot sweep never removes orphaned blob-*.tmp and .gitignore-*.tmp temporaries
